§ 01 · The Program

A complete
curriculum.

Every passage is written for true C1 advanced learners — substantial, scholarly texts spanning society and politics, business and economics, environment and ethics, technology and philosophy, and psychology and behavior. Each one is paired with eight carefully written comprehension questions, testing genuine command of abstraction, inference, and sophisticated argument at the level advanced fluency demands. Built for use inside classrooms, self-study programs, and advanced English courses.

DISCERN

Authentic content

Every passage reflects real, natural C1-level English drawn from genuinely substantive scholarly and public discourse.

EVALUATE

CEFR-aligned

Structured for true C1 comprehension — abstract argument, precise register, and genuinely sophisticated vocabulary.

SYNTHESIZE

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with a clear answer key showing exactly which choice was correct and why.

MASTER

Progress tracking

Your completed passages and scores are saved automatically, so you can revisit and improve over time.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Reading Comprehension Expert

Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for learners at every level. Diana takes her name from the Roman goddess of the moon — a steady, guiding light for readers navigating the more complex terrain advanced fluency requires.

Designed for C1 learners ready for genuine abstraction and argument — Diana is more than exercises. It's a guiding light through advanced material: the calm clarity that helps learners find their way through sophisticated argument and nuance.
